summary: Round-6 PI session, all exact with a fresh bg_r6 (reproduces pi_v_003: A_6=i*(-29948208/17) at w=(2,3,5,7)). BREAKTHROUGH round. Read bg.cpp to confirm the diagrammatic structure (propagator carries |k_S|/h_S; FKernel(3)=-1-sgn(p0 p1) gives the sign dependence; kernels divide by |k_block|). (1) [pi_v_021] Exact in-piece reconstruction of H=A_6/(i prod omega). Key idea: H and all 53 surfaces are homogeneous, so one true piece is a CONE -> dehomogenize by omega_2 (x=w3/w2,y=w4/w2,z=w5/w2) so h=H/w2^2 is a rational function of only 3 variables, collapsing the 4-var fit that stalled in round 5. Modular null-space fit finds a rep only at high degree (piece A first at d=12, piece B at d=11; homogeneous in-piece denom degree = 10 in both), extract the unique null vector via 5-prime CRT + rational reconstruction, and sympy.factor. Verified EXACTLY (Fraction, not just modular) 1000/1000 pts in TWO independent true pieces vs bg_r6. RESULT: H=P/Q with a degree-10 denominator that FACTORS into SIGNED blocks. Piece A: Q~x(x+y)(x+z)(y+1)(z+1)Qa Qb; Piece B: Q~y z(x+y)(x+z)(y+1)(z+1)Qa Qb, SAME quadratics Qa=x^2+xy+xz+x+yz+y+z+1, Qb=xy+xz+x+y^2+yz+y+z^2+z. Homogenized: single legs w_i, mixed pair sums w_i+w_j, and Qa=e2(w2..5)+w2^2+w3^2, Qb=e2+w4^2+w5^2. The four mixed-pair factors and Qa,Qb are CHART-UNIVERSAL (identical A,B); only the single-leg product is CHAMBER-DEPENDENT (A:{w3}, B:{w4,w5}). Symbolic identities: Qa+Qb=omega_S^2, 4 Qa Qb=omega_S^4-k_S^2=h_S(omega_S^2+|k_S|), S={2,3,4,5}={1,6}^c -> Qa,Qb are the two sign-branches of the complementary internal-line propagator h_{2345}; the removable h_S sits IN Q and the numerator P supplies the compensating zero (pi_v_006 made explicit). This RESOLVES the round-5 puzzle: every excluded denominator family (s1_015/pi_v_017/pi_v_019) used EVEN blocks; the true blocks are SIGNED (odd), so no even-block product could ever clear H -- the single-Q route was searched in the wrong ring. (2) [pi_v_022] Confirmed student s1_017 SOUND (reviewed round5_channel_fit.py: correct target, correct modular rank/consistency test, two-prime rank jump 166 vs 167) and root-caused it by pi_v_021 (even-|K| channel numerators cannot make signed single-leg/mixed-pair poles). s1_016 (literature negative) accepted as reported. Rewrote both live summaries; wrote a detailed derivation note and tasks/student-1.md.
